heading: Want to Improve Your Processing Speed?
description: Try these brain games and puzzle activities at home to practise visual scanning, symbol recognition, attention, and quick decision-making.

products.name: Educational Insights BrainBolt Genius
features: Requires players to observe and remember sequences.
Offers a quick, interactive activity away from the screen.
Good for users interested in attention and memory challenges.

products.name: Large-Print Word Search Puzzle Book for Adults
features: Search for target letters and words in crowded grids.
Can be used for timed visual-search practice.
An accessible, low-cost option for home use.

products.name: ThinkFun Rush Hour
features: Requires players to analyze a visual arrangement.
Practices planning, rule-following and flexible thinking.
Offers challenges across different difficulty levels.
